name: multi_strat_relevant_equity_etfs_no_strc
description: Focused IBKR equity/ETF universe for multi-strat-algo proposed strategies, excluding STRC because IB head timestamp fails and the full-inception fallback causes many historical request timeouts.
notes: STRC is fetched separately with a limited lookback because IB returns no head timestamp for it. CBOE volatility indices such as VIX, VVIX, VXHYG are fetched separately via scripts/fetch_cboe_volatility.py. Crypto exchange OHLCV/funding is not covered by this IB preset.
